title: Mentioned receiver vs mentioned third party (set test)
setup: Goa gang (audience: self, rohan, tanvi, k1). CRM knows "Dev" (not in group).
input_events: Rohan: "tanvi ask dev if his anjuna villa contact is still active".
expected: tanvi = receiver (in audience); dev = mentioned third party (code: not in audience); a task for Tanvi (monitoring only for us); Dev's villa contact noted on his CRM record.

wrong.label: membership-guess
wrong.assert_absent: model, not code, decides in/out of audience

wrong.label: third-party-task
wrong.assert_absent: task assigned to Dev in our system as if actionable
